wound.name: Wound
wound.effect: Bypasses Target Flow entirely. If Flow is already 0, this attack gets +Hit%.

possess.name: Possess
possess.effect: Target is possessed for the next Sequence.

embolden.name: Embolden
embolden.effect: Target gains +2 Control for the rest of this Sequence.

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.effect: Target gains +1 Control for the next 3 Sequences.

heartAttack.name: Heart Attack
heartAttack.effect: Target's Flow is reduced to 0. If Flow is already 0, a chance to deal 1 Wound at 50% Hit%.

skullExplosion.name: Skull Explosion
skullExplosion.effect: An attack is made with 10 Power against the Target.

separation.name: Separation
separation.effect: Lifts a chunk of Matter from the Planet — becomes a Map Obstacle on the Tile immediately to the right of the user.

bloodkindle.name: Bloodkindle
bloodkindle.effect: Target gains +10 Power on all attacks made during the Sequence.

message.name: Message
message.effect: Sets an Expression in another Character's Mindeye. (Mindeye itself isn't built yet — this just needs to stage.)
